# garmin-personal-mcp

> An MCP server that lets your assistant read your Garmin data through the official, read-only Garmin Connect Personal API: activities, laps, strength sets, sleep, HRV and more. It runs with `npx -y {{package}}` in every stdio MCP client and needs {{node}} and a Garmin Personal API key. It can also write a training dashboard: one offline HTML file.

The server is read-only: it writes nothing back to Garmin. Laps and strength sets come from the original .FIT files. A missing value or a failed call shows as "n/a"; the server and its prompts never invent data. Garmin does not endorse this project, and the project has no affiliation with Garmin.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/indaco/garmin-personal-mcp/blob/main/README.md): quick start, client setup, what you can ask, the tools and the dashboard prompts
- [Guide](https://github.com/indaco/garmin-personal-mcp/blob/main/guide/README.md): the index of the guide pages
- [How it works](https://github.com/indaco/garmin-personal-mcp/blob/main/guide/how-it-works.md): transport, authentication with the API key, laps and sets from the .FIT files, the automatic update and the dashboard cache
- [Tools](https://github.com/indaco/garmin-personal-mcp/blob/main/guide/tools.md): every tool, its endpoints, and the data that the Personal API does not have
- [Dashboard](https://github.com/indaco/garmin-personal-mcp/blob/main/guide/dashboard.md): make and update the page, show it in the chat, boards and widgets, themes, languages and page settings
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/indaco/garmin-personal-mcp/blob/main/guide/troubleshooting.md): problems and their solutions
